headline: Public hearings on 12 development applications, including subdivisions on Wellington Road and Elgin Avenue and a drive-through restaurant on Second Street.
summary: Three subdivision applications would create new building lots, including 34 lots on Wellington Road. Other items include extension requests for a car wash and a townhouse project, and a plan to add car sales at 792 Gold Street.
items: S2026-005: subdivision for 34 new lots on Wellington Road, continued from November 5, 2026
S2026-007: subdivision for 16 new lots at 1308 Wellington Road, continued from November 5, 2026
S2026-018: lot line adjustment at 333 Cohas Avenue, continued from November 5, 2026
SP2025-020 and CU2025-022: three-month extension for a car wash at 275 Hooksett Road
SP2025-023: three-month extension for converting office space into five apartments at 139 Central Street
PDSP2025-004: six-month extension for a 22-unit townhouse development on Wellington Road
SP2026-023: adding car sales to an auto repair business at 792 Gold Street
S2026-019: subdivision for 34 lots and a new city street at 388 Elgin Avenue
SP2026-021: reconfiguring and changing the use of 3,600 square feet at the hotel at 298 Queen City Avenue
CU2026-014: parking reduction and shared parking at 298 Queen City Avenue
SP2026-022: site plan for a 2,285 square foot drive-through restaurant at 500 Second Street
CU2026-015: parking reduction and shared parking at 500 Second Street
location: City Hall, Third Floor, Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, December 3, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
  
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
1. S2026-005 – Continued from November 5, 2026 
Property located at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30) , a subdivision application for the 
creation of 34 new buildable lots with new public roads and a wetland crossing, in the Lake 
Massabesic Protection Overlay and R -1A Zoning District. Granite Engineering, LLC for 
Manchester Water Works. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
2. S2026-007 – Continued from November 5, 2026 
Property located at 1308 Wellington Road  (Tax Map 860, Lot s 1 and 2A ), a subdivision 
application for the creation of 16 new buildable lots with new public roads, a wetland crossing, and 
water service proposed by easement, in the Lake Massabesic Protection Overlay and R -1A Zoning 
District. Arago Land Consultants, LLC for Manchester Christian Church.  (Reviewed under prior 
zoning ordinance). 
  
3. S2026-018 – Continued from November 5, 2026 
Property located at 333 Cohas Avenue (Tax Map 612, Lots 2 and 3), a subdivision/lot line 
adjustment application to annex Parcel A of 9,393 s.f. from Tax Map 612, Lot 2 to Tax Map 612, 
Lot 3, located in an R-1A Zoning District.  Lavelle Associates for Echelon Development, LLC. 
 
 (New Items) 
With respect to the following applications, appropriate materials have been submitted to invoke the 
jurisdiction of the Board. Although additional information may be required prior to final 
consideration, it is the recommendation of Staff that the Planning Board determine the applications 
complete and conduct a public hearing. A motion would be in order. 
  
4. SP2025-020 & CU2025-022 – Extension Request  
Property located at 275 Hooksett Road (Tax Map 913, Lot 21) , a three-month extension request 
for an approved site plan application for the construction of a car wash facility and a conditional 
use application for the reduction of parking where 45 parking spaces are provided where 89 would 
be required and 17 stacking spaces are provided where 20 are required in the BC -2 Zoning District. 
Keach-Nordstrom Associates, Inc. for State Motors.  (Reviewed under previous zoning ordinance).
Manchester Planning Board 
Public Hearing Meeting 
December 3, 2026

5. SP2025-023 - Extension Request 
Property located at 139 Central Street (Tax Map 102, Lot 51), as well as the three vacant lots  
to the east along Central Street (Tax Map 102, Lots 50, 49, and 48), a three-month extension 
request for the site plan application for the conversion of first floor office space into five new 
residential dwelling units in an existing mixed-use building with offices and eight existing dwelling 
units on the upper floors in an R-3 Zoning District.  Keach-Nordstrom Associates, Inc. for Central 
Street 289, LLC.  (Reviewed under previous zoning ordinance). 
 
6. PDSP2025-004 - Extension Request 
Property located at Wellington Road (Tax Map 645, Lot 39), a six-month extension request  
for the conditionally approved planned development and site plan application for a six building 
22-unit townhouse style development, with associated site improvements, in the former R-SM  
Zoning District. Granite Engineering, LLC for Brook Hollow Corp.  (Reviewed under previous  
zoning ordinance). 
  
7. SP2026-023 
Property located at 792 Gold Street (Tax Map 0875, Lot 5A), a site plan review application to 
add automobile sales to the existing automobile repair operation, in the BC-2 Zoning District.  
Dorin Bubuioc, Premium Auto House LLC and Joshua Cahill, Cahill Commercial Real Estate 
(Agents) for Oren & Beverly Stevens Rev. Tr. (Owner) (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
8. S2026-019  
Property located at 388 Elgin Avenue (Tax Map 556, Lot 105 and Tax Map 283, Lot 49), a 
subdivision application for the creation of 34 lots and to add a new city street, in the R-1A Zoning 
District.  Dubay Group for Steven H. Musial.  (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
9. SP2026-021 
Property located at 298 Queen City Avenue (Tax Map TPK2, Lot 20), a site plan review 
application for the internal reconfiguration and change of use of 3,600 s.f. of the hotel building and 
related site features, in the BC-2 Zoning District.  Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Om Siababa, LLC.  
(Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
10. CU2026-014 
Property located at 298 Queen City Avenue (Tax Map TPK2, Lot 20) , a conditional use permit 
application for a parking reduction where 158 parking spaces are required and 130 are proposed, 
and a shared parking arrangement with abutting Tax Map TPK2, Lot 22, in the BC -2 Zoning 
District.  Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Om Siababa, LLC. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
11. SP2026-022 
Property located at 500 Second Street (Tax Map TPK2, Lot 22) , a site plan review application to 
redevelop the site into a 2,285 s.f. Drive Through Restaurant, in the BC -2 Zoning District.  Fuss 
and O’Neill, Inc. for Virpa, LLC.  (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance).

III. ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS: 
 
1. Review and approval of the Planning Board minutes of November 5, 2026. 
 
2. Distribution of the Planning Board minutes of November 19, 2026, for review and approval at the 
meeting of December 17, 2026. 
 
3. Any other business items from the Planning Staff or Board Members. 
 
Full text of the agenda items is on file for review in the Planning & Community Development Department.
